title: Per-document extraction spec
description: How to read the tables of one bronze document into silver. One file per document: config/extraction/<doc_id>.yaml. Hand-written; never rewritten by scripts.

doc_id.description: Must match an id in data/bronze/source-docs-manifest.yaml.

cross_checks.description: Equalities between cells of different tables, e.g. a schedule total equals the statement total.

title.description: Statement or schedule name as printed.

role.description: headline: top-level statement; function_breakdown: expense by ministry/function (used for shares); function_by_object: sector x expense-type matrix; object_breakdown: expense by type only.

method.description: Extractor used. An LLM extractor can be added as another method.

scope.description: Reporting entity, e.g. consolidated_summary or general_revenue_fund.

columns.description: Column id -> attributes. fiscal_year and basis are required; any other key becomes a column dimension (e.g. sector).

kind.description: Default detail. memo: read for checks and reference (e.g. expense-type columns beside a total) but not mapped.

parts.description: One entry per page (or page region). Every part must yield one numeric line per row.

page.description: 1-based PDF page index (not the printed number).

start_after.description: Regex; the region starts after the first matching line.

end_at.description: Regex; the region ends at (and includes) the first matching line.

columns.description: Column ids left to right on this page.

unlabelled.description: Rows on this page print without labels (a continuation page of a wide table); match rows by order only.

label.description: Canonical label (as printed, footnote markers removed).

kind.description: Default detail. memo: extracted for reference (e.g. neighbouring lines in a statement) but never mapped or summed.

unlabelled.description: The row is printed without a label (e.g. an unlabelled total line); skip the label check.

sign.description: Multiply printed amounts by this (e.g. -1 where a statement prints an expense as a negative adjustment).

rows.description: rows_sum: labels to add (default: all detail rows).

equals.description: rows_sum: row label; columns_sum: column id.

columns.description: rows_sum: columns to check (default all); columns_sum: column ids to add.

for_rows.description: columns_sum: rows to check (default detail rows).

tolerance.description: Allowed rounding difference in printed units (default 0).

drop_chars.description: Characters removed before reading words, e.g. ['.'] for dot leaders interleaved with text (BC). Only for integer tables.

x_tolerance.description: pdfplumber x_tolerance for joining characters into words (default 1.5).

merge_split_digits.description: Rejoin amounts the PDF splits into pieces (Alberta prints '3 0,465' for 30,465). Drops lone '$' tokens.

ignore_unaligned_numbers.description: Numbers that don't sit under any column (e.g. a 'Note' or 'Schedule' reference column) are treated as label text instead of failing.

space_thousands.description: Amounts use spaces as thousands separators (Quebec: '65 527'). Pieces closer than the merge gap are joined.
